# Nasma

Nasma logs cigarettes and shisha (waterpipe) sessions in their own units, shows the money and time kept, and supports Ramadan and the Hijri calendar. Everything is stored on the device: no account, no network, no ads. One-time purchase, no subscription.

- Home: https://freetokyo.github.io/web/nasma/
- Arabic: https://freetokyo.github.io/web/nasma/ar/
- English: https://freetokyo.github.io/web/nasma/en/
- Privacy: https://freetokyo.github.io/web/nasma/privacy.html
- Terms: https://freetokyo.github.io/web/nasma/terms.html
- Support: https://freetokyo.github.io/web/nasma/support.html
- Contact: freetokyo2020@yahoo.co.jp
